completion_data.completion_summary: Added a structured completion-time reflection object surfaced through .return-meta.json, persisted with overwrite semantics on state.json at the orchestrator-postflight.sh completion seam, logged as a reflection event, surfaced read-only in skill-todo's harvest prompt, and functionally included in /learn --task N.

memory_candidates.content: When a new free-text object field must be written into a shared JSON state file (like state.json) alongside existing fields written via a python3 triple-quote bash-interpolation pattern, don't extend that pattern to the new field. Use `jq --argjson VAR "$json_var"` instead — it passes the JSON value as a genuine argument rather than string-interpolating it into script source, so embedded quotes/newlines in free text can never break the write.

When adding a new top-level metadata field alongside an existing append-semantics field (e.g. memory_candidates), state its overwrite-vs-append semantics explicitly in both the producer-side format doc (return-metadata-file.md) and the consumer-side schema doc (state-management-schema.md), mirroring the existing field's documentation structure exactly. This keeps producer/consumer docs mechanically consistent and makes the semantic difference (overwrite vs append) impossible to miss during future edits.

next_steps: No further action required. The reflection field is now live end-to-end: implementation agents may emit .return-meta.json's reflection object, postflight will persist it, and /todo + /learn --task N will surface it.
